text: Jordan had a phone screen with Ana at Northlight that went well—Jordan opened up about the failed early dashboard attempts and talked at length about the personal Coda project, and Ana seemed genuinely impressed, especially by Jordan's honesty about not noticing the trophy-case usage pattern despite using the feature daily. Jordan was elated afterward (an onsite is scheduled in two weeks, with Northlight hoping to hire by October), and processed the excitement with a run at Greenwood Park, reflecting that the looming reorg under Priya feels far less threatening now that there's an alternative door open. Jordan told Lena, Mika, Dev, and Mom right away, but kept it quiet at work.
